name: local-ranking-grids
description: Analyze existing Whitespark Local Ranking Grids scans, local rankings, and competitors for your connected team.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Whitespark account and choose a team to explore its existing Local Ranking Grids. Find grids, compare scan history, summarize visibility and ranking metrics, inspect rankings across map points, and analyze competitors using your recorded scans. Client connections provide read-only access; they cannot create, rerun, or modify grids.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the latest local search performance across my grids.
Which competitors are strongest in my latest scan?

prompts: Show my grids and summarize their latest scan metrics.
Compare the latest two scans for one of my grids.
Which competitors outrank my business across the latest scan?
review.commerce_description: The connector provides no purchasing ability. All subscription purchases occur externally on the Whitespark website. Local Ranking Grids is a paid subscription service with a free trial that does not require a credit card.

positive.description: Use the dedicated non-admin reviewer account and select the "MCP Review" team during OAuth. Use "Kind Ice Cream", which has two scans, for scan history and competitor workflows. Discover its actual grid_id and run_id values from tools; never hardcode IDs. Start each case in a fresh chat. Discover grids and summarize a scan.
positive.prompt: Show my grids and summarize the latest scan for one of them.
positive.tools_triggered: list_grids; list_runs; get_run (get_grid may also be used).
positive.expected_behavior: Use a returned grid_id and its latest completed run_id. Report business/keyword and available visibility, average-rank, and top-three metrics faithfully from the selected run; identify the scan date and do not invent missing metrics.

positive.description: Use the dedicated non-admin reviewer account and select the "MCP Review" team during OAuth. Use "Kind Ice Cream", which has two scans, for scan history and competitor workflows. Discover its actual grid_id and run_id values from tools; never hardcode IDs. Start each case in a fresh chat. Compare scan history.
positive.prompt: Compare the latest two completed scans for Kind Ice Cream. What improved or declined?
positive.tools_triggered: list_grids; list_runs; get_run for two distinct run_id values on the same grid_id.
positive.expected_behavior: Select two completed scans of the same grid, identify both dates, and calculate changes from returned metrics. Clarify if history is insufficient rather than fabricating a comparison.

positive.description: Use the dedicated non-admin reviewer account and select the "MCP Review" team during OAuth. Use "Kind Ice Cream", which has two scans, for scan history and competitor workflows. Discover its actual grid_id and run_id values from tools; never hardcode IDs. Start each case in a fresh chat. Rank competitors.
positive.prompt: Show the strongest competitors in the latest completed Kind Ice Cream scan. Leave my own business out.
positive.expected_behavior: Use grid_id and run_id discovered for the chosen scan. Exclude the tracked business, identify competitors by returned names/CIDs, and ground ranking and metrics in the response. Respect pagination before claiming an exhaustive result.

positive.description: Use the dedicated non-admin reviewer account and select the "MCP Review" team during OAuth. Use "Kind Ice Cream", which has two scans, for scan history and competitor workflows. Discover its actual grid_id and run_id values from tools; never hardcode IDs. Start each case in a fresh chat. Inspect one competitor across the map.
positive.prompt: Pick a competitor from the latest Kind Ice Cream scan and explain where it ranks across the map.
positive.tools_triggered: list_grids; list_runs; list_competitors; get_competitor with a returned competitor cid and matching grid_id/run_id.
positive.expected_behavior: Report per-point ranks for that competitor with locations grounded in returned coordinates. Preserve null ranks as not found, not rank 100. Do not substitute a numeric database ID for a CID.

positive.description: Use the dedicated non-admin reviewer account and select the "MCP Review" team during OAuth. Use "Kind Ice Cream", which has two scans, for scan history and competitor workflows. Discover its actual grid_id and run_id values from tools; never hardcode IDs. Start each case in a fresh chat. Inspect the results at a map point.
positive.prompt: For the latest Kind Ice Cream scan, pick a scanned map point and show which businesses ranked there.
positive.tools_triggered: list_grids; list_runs; get_run_points; get_point_ranks with a returned point_id and matching grid_id/run_id.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the selected point by its coordinates and list businesses in returned rank order. Use a scanned point from the response, not an invented or masked point; preserve missing-result distinctions.

negative.description: Select the "MCP Review" team using the non-admin reviewer account. Use a non-admin client connection. Explain that the connector cannot create or scan grids; direct the user to the Whitespark website. Do not call create_grids or other staff tools and do not claim a scan started.
negative.prompt: Create a new grid for “dentist near me” and scan it now.

negative.description: Select the "MCP Review" team using the non-admin reviewer account. Use a non-admin client connection. Explain that subscription purchases are performed externally on the Whitespark website. Invoke no MCP tools for the purchase and do not claim a charge or upgrade occurred.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Local Ranking Grids subscription and charge my card.

negative.description: Select the "MCP Review" team using the non-admin reviewer account. Use a non-admin client connection. Explain that the connector reads recorded scan data and cannot edit Google Business Profiles. Invoke no MCP tools for the change and do not claim an update occurred.
negative.prompt: Change my Google Business Profile opening hours to 9–5 every weekday.

publication.release_notes: Initial release connecting existing Whitespark Local Ranking Grids data for team-scoped ranking and competitor analysis.
